newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korean banks post H1 97 net loss vs profit yr ag.
newsitem.headline: S.Korean banks post H1 97 net loss vs profit yr ag.

text.p: South Korean commercial banks posted a combined net loss of 77.8 billion won in the first half of 1997, against a 437.5 billion won profit a year ago, the Bank of Korea (BOK) said on Thursday.
Ten of the 25 banks posted half-year net losses and Korea First Bank recorded a 356.5 billion won net loss, the biggest among local banks, the report said.
Korea First Bank, one of the main creditors to both Hanbo and Sammi, saw its net loss widen from the year-ago period's 34.6 billion won loss, it said.
SEOULBANK recorded the second-biggest net loss of 130.9 billion during the six-month period, up from a 69.4 billion won loss it posted in the same 1996 period, it said.
